implementation: SmartPass Version 4.X with a FIPS or VCAT Token
description: SmartPass is V-ONE SmartGate's client software; it runs on the end user's computer and manages user authentication and data encryption/decryption between the user's computer and the SmartGate Server. If the user registers with V-ONE's patented On-Line Registration (OLR) technology then the server information will be stored in a secure FIPS 140-1 token, which may be stored on a hard drive, floppy disk, or a smartcard.
